name: Tokyo-Teleport
tagline: Shinagawa in 22 minutes and Shibuya in 28 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Rinkai Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 33 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 22 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4 m to 6.8 m, a difference of 2.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is フジテレビ湾岸スタジオビル診療所, about 13 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 癌研有明病院, about 27 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Rinkai Line.
congestion: Rinkai Line runs at 118% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川シーサイド, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, 1LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000 and 2LDK ¥430,000 to ¥440,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Odaiba-Kaihinkoen is ahead on quiet, but Tokyo-Teleport is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Tokyo-Teleport. It reaches Otemachi 4 minutes sooner than Tokyo-Teleport.

noiseSources: The 首都高速湾岸線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
東京湾岸道路 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 5 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Rinkai Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
